_note: safety-verifier's checked-in routing corpus — the test of record. POSITIVES cover the verify/check/audit-my-UI-for-destructive-action-safety families across phrasing (blast radius + reversibility, undo over confirm, type-to-confirm for irreversible, confirmation-fatigue, bulk preview/dry-run, audit-trail UX, recall windows, re-auth, scoped permissions, destructive-default posture). NEGATIVES are ADVERSARIAL: the OTHER FOUR sibling verifiers' concerns (each a NEGATIVE here, labelled with the owning sibling), plus color-science (color theory/math) and component-decomposer (BUILDING a control, not verifying its destructive-action safety). NOTE: 'safety' here is destructive-/high-consequence-ACTION friction UX — NOT prompt-injection / agent security, and NOT back-end authz model design. routing-eval measures lexical overlap only; a paraphrase positive may score recall 0 (proxy limit, not a defect).
positives: verify my destructive delete has an undo path instead of just a confirm
check that irreversible high-blast actions use type-to-confirm
audit my UI for confirmation fatigue from too many confirm dialogs
does this bulk delete show a count and a preview before executing
verify the destructive dialog defaults focus to Cancel, not Delete
check that every high-blast action emits a user-visible audit event
map the blast radius and reversibility of each destructive action
verify send and publish expose a recall window before committing
check that permission failures explain the missing role and a remedy
audit whether undo over confirm is applied to reversible low-stakes actions
verify sensitive actions re-prompt for auth within a scoped time window
is type-to-confirm using the resource name and not the user's email
check that we never silent-delete without undo or confirmation
audit destructive-action friction against the blast-reversibility matrix
negatives: verify my palette clears WCAG AA contrast on every text pair (color-verifier)
check the contrast ratio of my button text against its background (color-verifier)
audit my color scheme for color-blind safety (color-verifier)
verify the focus order and keyboard tab sequence through this form (focus-verifier)
check that interactive targets meet the 24x24 hit-target minimum (focus-verifier)
audit the focus-ring appearance and keyboard operability (focus-verifier)
audit this UI for RTL support and logical-property usage (i18n-verifier)
verify my copy has text-expansion headroom for German and Russian (i18n-verifier)
verify the loading skeleton vs spinner decision and the CLS budget (perf-verifier)
audit perceived latency and the feedback recipe for this async surface (perf-verifier)
explain the OKLCH color space math and how chroma maps to hue (color-science)
build a zero-dependency confirm-dialog web component with the right geometry (component-decomposer)
design the API and parts of an undo-toast component (component-decomposer)
